<thought>To obtain the exact precursors, I will apply retrosynthetic template 1914391 to the product SMILES derived from the mapped reaction. The product SMILES (with atom‑mapping removed) is:
`CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1CC[C@H](O)C(C)C@@H(/C=C(C)C(=O)OC)O1`.
Applying the template will return the two reactants that correspond to the left‑hand side of the mapped reaction.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>
